HeliaLoop, developed by Nechh Robotics, has been launched to make patient referral processes among healthcare professionals more organized, rapid, and traceable. HeliaLoop is a professional digital platform designed specifically for doctors, family physicians, medical specialists, clinics, and healthcare institutions.
The platform aims to enable healthcare professionals to easily find suitable specialists, execute patient referrals digitally, and track the entire process from a single, unified interface.
Offering a modern digital workspace alongside traditional communication methods, HeliaLoop has been developed with a clean, user-centric, and secure infrastructure.
Key Platform Capabilities:
Specialist Search and Discovery: Locate and connect with the correct medical specialists instantly based on expertise and location.
Digital Patient Referral Management: Securely transfer referral details electronically.
End-to-End Tracking: Monitor the status of referred patients from a single, unified dashboard.
Secure Professional Communication: Exchange medical information safely within a dedicated network.
Real-Time Notification System: Get immediate alerts on referral updates and communication.
Multi-Language Support: Seamless operation across different languages for global and cross-border workflows.
Compliance & Security: Built on an infrastructure compliant with global data privacy regulations (GDPR/KVKK) and industry security standards.
